moworks.notes: Only around the cut (recipe 100 ms either side; demo the middle 40 % of the transition): 6 horizontal slices re-seeded ~40 times per transition, 6-24 px tall, x +-30 px, alternately showing scene A or B; a full-frame red overlay at 35 % offset 4 px (RGB split; recipe 4-8 px, 3-5 slices). Cut at the midpoint; clean frames outside the window. Params: duration (0.2 s) · slices (3–5) · amp (4–8 px).
